title: Declaration of Building Structure and Components
summary: This thread pertains to the formal declaration of building structures and raw materials/components, where the proprietor is identified as a signatory alongside other management personnel. Unlike the inspection reports, this focuses on the declaration of materials and structural compliance.

evolution.scope: Focuses on structural/material declaration rather than general factory inspection.

timeline.change: Introduction of a declaration form requiring signature from the proprietor or chief executive.

Form: This instrument provides a standard format for declaring pre-fabricated building structure components or raw materials. The form requires the reporting of company identification, contact details, and tax registration numbers.
The declaration form includes a signature block for the relevant VAT commissioner and must be signed by the managing director, chief executive, or proprietor of the business entity.
National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the issuing authority for this regulatory instrument regarding the declaration of pre-fabricated building structural components.
